title: sdks: unify auth/retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity fixes & version bumps (py/ts/go)
author: Priya Singh
description: Summary: This PR coordinates SDK parity work across Python, TypeScript, and Go. It unifies the auth/retries behavior, simplifies streaming ergonomics, fixes parity gaps between SDKs, and bumps package versions for a coordinated release. Motivation: subtle behavioral differences across SDKs (auth token refresh timing, backoff defaults, streaming buffer APIs) caused customer confusion and intermittent regressions. Changes: Introduce common AuthProvider interface behavior to align token refresh timing and error mapping across SDKs; move retry policy defaults to a shared semantics doc and update SDKs to match (exponential backoff with jitter, 3 retries for idempotent calls, 2 for streaming connect by default); add start_stream helper and consumer-friendly iterator/async iterator wrappers in Python/TS and a channel-based wrapper in Go; parity fixes to ensure function/tool-calling metadata present in TS and Go, and add missing error code mappings; bump versions: python 1.9.0, typescript 0.13.0, go v0.8.0. Checklist: [x] Design spec (ENG-2310) reviewed; [x] Unit + integration tests added; [x] Docs examples updated; [x] Release notes drafted; [x] CI green; [x] Package versions bumped and changelogs updated. Notes: Breaking changes kept minimal; streaming helper is additive and old APIs remain supported for one release cycle. See linked Linear items for follow-ups.

fix(python): align retry default and add start_stream helper with iterator wrapper
feat(ts): add streaming iterator + retry policy parity and update README examples

release_notes: SDKs: Unify auth provider behavior across languages; token refresh window now defaults to 30s before expiry.
SDKs: Standardized retry defaults (exponential backoff + jitter). Idempotent requests: 3 retries; streaming connect: 2 retries by default.
Python: new start_stream helper with iterator/async iterator ergonomics.
TypeScript: streaming iterator helper and function-calling parity fixes.
Go: channel-based stream wrapper and error-code mappings.
Package bumps: python 1.9.0, typescript 0.13.0, go v0.8.0.
